### Interface as built

**`gov doctor [--json]`** (read command, exit 0 healthy / exit 3 unhealthy)
- 11 checks: `tools`, `hooks`, `path_map`, `path_compliance`, `index_freshness`, `canaries`, `framework_lock`, `isolation`, `adoption_level`, `claude_code`, `held_out`
- Each check returns `{status: pass|fail|drift|unmeasured, ...details}`
- Aggregated result: `healthy: true/false`
- Raises `GovError("DOCTOR_UNHEALTHY", exit_code=3)` if any check fails or drifts

**`gov rebuild`** (act command)
- Recreates record graph via `gov.store.load`
- Creates lexical tables via DDL (preserves existing data)
- Reports `{digest, store, skipped}` — skipped names stores requiring external tools (semantic → ollama, codeintel → code intelligence tool)
- Two consecutive rebuilds produce the same digest

**`gov.rebuild.check`** (recovery-rebuild family check)
- Registered in `template/governance/kernel/checks/recovery-rebuild.yaml`
- Runs `python3 -m gov.rebuild.check`
- Computes current store digest, rebuilds in throwaway tmpdir, compares
- Exit 0 match, exit 1 mismatch or store absent
